---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AuxTL == INSTANCE TLAPS
LEMMA AuxHelperUnchangedOps == ops' = ops => (SnapshotIsolation <=> SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperRouterStart == \A r \in Router, t \in TxId, ts \in Timestamps : RouterTxnStart(r, t, ts) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF RouterTxnStart, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperRouterOp == \A r \in Router, s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys, op \in Ops : RouterTxnOp(r, s, t, k, op) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF RouterTxnOp, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperRouterCoordCommit == \A r \in Router, s \in Shard, t \in TxId, op \in Ops : RouterTxnCoordinateCommit(r, s, t, op) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF RouterTxnCoordinateCommit, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperRouterReadOnly == \A r \in Router, s \in Shard, t \in TxId : RouterTxnCommitReadOnly(r, s, t) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF RouterTxnCommitReadOnly, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperRouterSingle == \A r \in Router, s \in Shard, t \in TxId : RouterTxnCommitSingleShard(r, s, t) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF RouterTxnCommitSingleShard, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardStart == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnStart(s, tid) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnStart, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardRead == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId, k \in Keys, v \in TxId \cup {NoValue} : ShardTxnRead(s, tid, k, v) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnRead, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardWrite == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId, k \in Keys : ShardTxnWrite(s, tid, k) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnWrite, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardCoordCommit == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnCoordinateCommit(s, tid) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnCoordinateCommit, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardRecvVote == \A s, from \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnCoordinatorRecvCommitVote(s, tid, from) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnCoordinatorRecvCommitVote, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardDecide == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnCoordinatorDecideCommit(s, tid) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnCoordinatorDecideCommit, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardPrepare == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnPrepare(s, tid) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnPrepare, SnapshotIsolation
LEMMA AuxHelperShardAbort == \A s \in Shard, tid \in TxId : ShardTxnAbort(s, tid) => (SnapshotIsolation => SnapshotIsolation')
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF ShardTxnAbort, SnapshotIsolation
AuxMyFSingle == [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE {<< <<>> >>}]
AuxMyRHSSingle == [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in AuxMyFSingle[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]
LEMMA AuxHelperMyFSatSingle == AuxMyFSingle = AuxMyRHSSingle
  <1>1 DOMAIN AuxMyFSingle = SUBSET {<<>>} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyFSingle
  <1>2 DOMAIN AuxMyRHSSingle = SUBSET {<<>>} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyRHSSingle
  <1>3 AuxMyFSingle[{}] = AuxMyRHSSingle[{}] BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyFSingle, AuxMyRHSSingle
  <1>4 AuxMyFSingle[{<<>>}] = AuxMyRHSSingle[{<<>>}] BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyFSingle, AuxMyRHSSingle
  <1>5 SUBSET {<<>>} = {{}, {<<>>}} BY AuxTL!Isa
  <1>6 QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5 DEF AuxMyFSingle, AuxMyRHSSingle
LEMMA AuxHelperExistsSingle == \E p : p = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in p[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]
  <1>1 AuxMyFSingle = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in AuxMyFSingle[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}] BY AuxHelperMyFSatSingle DEF AuxMyRHSSingle
  <1>2 QED BY <1>1
LEMMA AuxHelperUniqueSingle == \A p : (p = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in p[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]) => p[{<<>>}] = {<< <<>> >>}
  <1>1 \A p : (p = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in p[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]) => p[{}] = {<<>>}
    <2>1 TAKE p
    <2>2 HAVE p = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in p[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]
    <2>3 {} \in SUBSET {<<>>} BY AuxTL!Isa
    <2>4 QED BY <2>2, <2>3
  <1>2 QED BY <1>1
LEMMA AuxHelperPermSingle == PermSeqs({<<>>}) = {<< <<>> >>}
  <1>1 \E p : p = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in p[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}] BY AuxHelperExistsSingle
  <1>2 \A p : (p = [ss \in SUBSET {<<>>} |-> IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>} ELSE LET ps == [x \in ss |-> {Append(sq, x) : sq \in p[ss \ {x}]}] IN UNION {ps[x] : x \in ss}]) => p[{<<>>}] = {<< <<>> >>} BY AuxHelperUniqueSingle
  <1>3 QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF PermSeqs, AuxMyFSingle
LEMMA AuxHelperRangeEmpty == TxId = {} => (LET o == [s \in TxId |-> <<>>] IN Range(o) = {}) 
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF Range
LEMMA AuxHelperRangeSingle == TxId # {} => (LET o == [s \in TxId |-> <<>>] IN Range(o) = {<<>>})
  PROOF BY AuxTL!Isa DEF Range
AuxMyFEmpty == [ss \in SUBSET {} |-> {<<>>}]
LEMMA AuxHelperMyFEmptyDom == DOMAIN AuxMyFEmpty = SUBSET {} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyFEmpty
LEMMA AuxHelperMyFEmptyVal == AuxMyFEmpty[{}] = {<<>>} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyFEmpty
LEMMA AuxHelperSubEmpty == SUBSET {} = {{}} BY AuxTL!Isa
LEMMA AuxHelperPermEmpty == PermSeqs({}) = {<<>>}
  <1>1 SUBSET {} = {{}} BY AuxTL!Isa
  <1>2 AuxMyFEmpty[{}] = {<<>>} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyFEmpty
  <1>3 QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF PermSeqs, AuxMyFEmpty
AuxMyIterEmpty(base) == [s \in SUBSET {} |-> base]
LEMMA AuxHelperFoldEmpty == ASSUME NEW op2(_, _), NEW base2, NEW fun2 PROVE FoldFunctionOnSet(op2, base2, fun2, {}) = base2
  <1>1 DOMAIN AuxMyIterEmpty(base2) = SUBSET {} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyIterEmpty
  <1>2 AuxMyIterEmpty(base2)[{}] = base2 BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyIterEmpty
  <1>3 SUBSET {} = {{}} BY AuxTL!Isa
  <1>4 AuxMyIterEmpty(base2) = [s \in SUBSET {} |-> IF s = {} THEN base2 ELSE LET x == (CHOOSE x \in s : TRUE) IN op2(fun2[x], AuxMyIterEmpty(base2)[s \ {x}])] BY AuxTL!Isa DEF AuxMyIterEmpty
  <1>5 QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF FoldFunctionOnSet, MapThenFoldSet
LEMMA AuxHelperReduceEmpty == ASSUME NEW op3(_, _), NEW base3 PROVE ReduceSeq(op3, <<>>, base3) = base3
  <1>1 DOMAIN <<>> = {} BY AuxTL!Isa
  <1>2 QED BY <1>1, AuxHelperFoldEmpty, AuxTL!Isa DEF ReduceSeq, FoldFunction
LEMMA AuxHelperDomainEmptySeq == DOMAIN <<>> = {} BY AuxTL!Isa
LEMMA AuxHelperSeqToSetEmpty == SeqToSet(<<>>) = {} BY AuxTL!Isa DEF SeqToSet
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM SnapshotIsolationCorrect ==
    (Spec /\ []SingleWritePerKey) => []SnapshotIsolation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
PROOF
  <1>1 Init /\ SingleWritePerKey => SnapshotIsolation BY AuxHelperPermSingle, AuxHelperRangeEmpty, AuxHelperRangeSingle, AuxHelperMyFSatSingle, AuxHelperExistsSingle, AuxHelperUniqueSingle, AuxHelperMyFEmptyDom, AuxHelperMyFEmptyVal, AuxHelperSubEmpty, AuxHelperPermEmpty, AuxHelperFoldEmpty, AuxHelperReduceEmpty, AuxHelperDomainEmptySeq, AuxHelperSeqToSetEmpty, AuxTL!Isa DEF Init, SnapshotIsolation, SingleWritePerKey, WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce
  <1>2 SnapshotIsolation /\ SingleWritePerKey /\ SingleWritePerKey' /\ [Next]_vars => SnapshotIsolation'
    BY AuxHelperUnchangedOps, AuxHelperRouterStart, AuxHelperRouterOp, AuxHelperRouterCoordCommit, AuxHelperRouterReadOnly, AuxHelperRouterSingle, AuxHelperShardStart, AuxHelperShardRead, AuxHelperShardWrite, AuxHelperShardCoordCommit, AuxHelperShardRecvVote, AuxHelperShardDecide, AuxHelperShardPrepare, AuxHelperShardAbort, AuxHelperPermSingle, AuxHelperRangeEmpty, AuxHelperRangeSingle, AuxHelperMyFEmptyDom, AuxHelperPermEmpty, AuxHelperFoldEmpty, AuxHelperReduceEmpty, AuxHelperDomainEmptySeq, AuxHelperSeqToSetEmpty, AuxTL!Isa DEF Next, vars, SnapshotIsolation, SingleWritePerKey, WritesEachKeyAtMostOnce
  <1>3 QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AuxTL!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF MongoDB/MultiShardTxnSnapshot_SnapshotIsolationCorrect.tla
====
